proposal.reason: Both experiments with the initial policy and the revised policy (with refresh_quote_before_order set to true) completed successfully, fulfilling the goal of purchasing 6 lights and 3 tents within the budget of 500. The initial policy achieved the same outcome without requiring a quote refresh, indicating that the current setting is effective. No failures or deviations from the goal were observed in either experiment.
